design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values as it analyzes process data rather than ILSA achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Matching text-readable full PDF has no explicit statement that ILSA sampling weights were omitted; weight references concern model parameters, outcome scaling, data variables or class/pixel weighting, not demonstrated sample-weight use.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, focusing instead on process data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The excerpts do not mention any validation strategies such as cross-validation or external validation.
